n1.text:
PM notes · Citizen app

• Report in ≤ 60 seconds, 3 steps max
• Must run on low-end Android; light first load, compressed photos, offline drafts
• Anonymous by default for sensitive categories; photo GPS/EXIF stripped
• Duplicate check before submit → nudge to 'Me too' instead
• Resolution is confirmed by the citizen, not only the agency

Click the green buttons in Play mode to walk the flow.

n2.text:
Why WhatsApp in the MVP

• It's where users already are: no install, no new habit
• Voice notes remove literacy and language barriers
• Same backend + status model as the app; updates pushed back into the chat
• Needs WhatsApp Business API (Meta Cloud API directly is cheapest for a side project)

n3.text:
USSD · DEFERRED (side project)

• Reaches feature phones and people without data
• Needs a telco shortcode via an aggregator, plus per-session fees: too much cost and admin for v1
• Revisit once there's a grant or a partner NGO
• ≤ 160 characters per screen, State → LGA → Ward menus, SMS follow-up

n4.text:
Decisions · 19 Oct

✔ Positioning: independent watchdog. Push for accountability AND celebrate wins
✔ Pilot: Lagos + FCT Abuja
✔ Team: side project → WhatsApp + web only
✔ Police misconduct in v1 (protected flow, row 4)
✔ Corruption (bribes in offices, contracts, budgets) → v2

Still open: is police extortion at checkpoints 'police' (v1) or 'corruption' (v2)? Assumed v1.

n5.text:
Status model (shared by every channel)

Received → Verified → Forwarded → Acknowledged → Resolved (citizen-confirmed) / Unresolved

• Target: agency acknowledges within 7 days
• 'Resolved' becomes final only after the reporter confirms or 14 days pass with no reply
• Each change notifies the reporter on the channel they used

n6.text:
Watchdog + side project cut

• 3.1 ships as a lite version for you and 1–2 volunteer moderators
• 3.2 Agency dashboard → LATER. Watchdog model: forward by email and tag the agency's public handles; agencies reply through a public 'Respond to this issue' link (no login)
• 3.3 Scorecard is the core watchdog product: ship it in v1

n7.text:
Police reporting safeguards (non-negotiable)

• No account, no phone number stored, no IP logs
• Faces and plate numbers auto-blurred; EXIF stripped on the device
• Never published one by one: only patterns, location fuzzed to ~1 km, at least 48h delay
• Officer names are never published; unit or vehicle details go only to the Police Complaint Response Unit / Police Service Commission
• Quick-exit button; reports aren't kept in the phone's history
• Legal review before launch (defamation, Cybercrimes Act exposure)
• Optional referral to a legal-aid partner

n8.text:
Why 'Wins' matters for a watchdog

• Watchdogs that only criticise get ignored or attacked. Celebrating fixes gives officials a reason to engage
• Before/after photos and citizen confirmation make wins credible
• Share cards on WhatsApp/X are your growth loop
• 'Most responsive agency' each month: earned, never paid
